name: Fatui
description:
Several members of the Fatui appear within the game as enemies that players can fight; Fatui Skirmishers, Fatui Cicin Mages, Fatui Pyro Agents, Mirror Maidens and Fatui Operatives. Each type of Fatui enemy is listed below.
 Like enemies from Other Human Factions, Fatui enemies have -20% resistance against Physical Damage.
